application.name: Depth to Point Cloud
application.description: Deprojects depth images into organized, colored PointCloud messages on the GPU with holoscan-point-cloud's DepthToPointCloudOp, with the depth camera's CameraInfo from a ROS camera_info file through holoscan-messages' CameraInfoSourceOp, from a synthetic depth camera checked point by point against ground truth, or from a folder of PGM depth images, and can write the clouds as PLY files.

changelog.2.0.0: holoscan-point-cloud 2.0: the camera comes from a camera_info file through CameraInfoSourceOp (written at run time for the synthetic camera, --camera-info for depth images) or with every synthetic frame, and the clouds are PointCloud messages; --fx, --fy, --cx, --cy and --intrinsics-input are gone.
changelog.1.0.0: Initial release: the holoscan-point-cloud demo, with synthetic and PGM depth sources, a ground-truth reporter and PLY output.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK.

synthetic.description: Deproject 300 frames of a synthetic depth camera with color, checking every point and color against ground truth.

images.description: Deproject the 8- or 16-bit PGM depth images in the data directory, with the camera_info.yaml file next to them.

ci.description: Finite headless check: 30 synthetic uint16 frames with color and the camera from a camera_info file, every point and color checked against ground truth.
